name: Dynamic railway timetable rescheduling for multiple connected disruptions
description: Mined from Dynamic railway timetable rescheduling for multiple connected disruptions (Transportation Research Part C Emerging Technologies, 2021).

provenance.reference: Dynamic railway timetable rescheduling for multiple connected disruptions
provenance.author: Yongqiu Zhu; Rob M.P. Goverde

indices.name: A
indices.description: Set of activities (run, station, turn, odturn).

indices.name: N
indices.description: Number of platform or pass-through tracks at a station.

indices.name: E_turn_de
indices.description: Set of departure events of turn activities.

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: Fixed penalty for each cancelled service.

parameters.name: M
parameters.description: Large positive number (M1, M2) used in big-M constraints.

parameters.name: o
parameters.description: Original scheduled time of event e.

parameters.name: D
parameters.description: Maximum allowed delay for events not in E_NMdelay.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: Number of disruptions (current disruption index).

parameters.name: R
parameters.description: Required recovery time length after disruptions.

parameters.name: T
parameters.description: Time-related parameters (t_start, t_end).

parameters.name: S
parameters.description: Station-related parameters (s_t, s_t_en, s_t_ex).

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: Platform track index (i) or pass-through track index (j).

parameters.name: tail
parameters.description: Function returning the tail event of an activity.

parameters.name: head
parameters.description: Function returning the head event of an activity.

parameters.name: L
parameters.description: Minimum duration required for short-turn activity a.

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Minimum time interval between events e and e' on same track.

parameters.name: st
parameters.description: Scheduled time

parameters.name: tr
parameters.description: Train of event

parameters.name: t
parameters.description: Time

parameters.name: t_start
parameters.description: earliest allowed time

parameters.name: t_end
parameters.description: latest allowed time

parameters.name: E_de
parameters.description: parameter: the index family of this name used as a number

parameters.name: E_turn_de
parameters.description: parameter: the index family of this name used as a number

parameters.name: M_1
parameters.description: parameter: the paper says so (Table 12)

parameters.name: M_2
parameters.description: parameter: the paper says so (Table 12)

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: parameter: the paper says so (paragraph 43)

parameters.name: t_1_end
parameters.description: parameter: variant of the declared parameter t

parameters.name: t_n_end
parameters.description: parameter: variant of the declared parameter t

parameters.name: t_n_start
parameters.description: parameter: variant of the declared parameter t

parameters.name: n2_x_D
parameters.description: derived: 2 * D

variables.name: c
variables.description: Binary decision variable indicating whether event e is cancelled (1) or not (0).

variables.name: d
variables.description: Delay of event e relative to original schedule.

variables.name: y
variables.description: Binary variable indicating if station of event e is chosen as short-turn station.

variables.name: m
variables.description: Binary variable indicating if short-turn activity a is selected.

variables.name: u
variables.description: Binary variable indicating if train occupies platform track i at station.

variables.name: v
variables.description: Binary variable indicating if train occupies pass-through track j at station.

variables.name: q
variables.description: Binary variable indicating if event e occurs before event e'.

variables.name: s
variables.description: Binary parameter indicating if a station activity is a true stop (0) or not (1).

constraints.name: eq_0009
constraints.description: Station activity consistency with arrival short-turn option: c_e <= c_e'.

constraints.name: eq_0011
constraints.description: Station activity consistency with arrival short-turn option: c_e' >= y_e.

constraints.name: eq_0013
constraints.description: Station activity consistency with departure short-turn option: c_e >= y_e'.

constraints.name: eq_0014
constraints.description: Both events have short-turn options: c_e - c_e' = y_e' - y_e.

constraints.name: eq_0015
constraints.description: At most one of both short-turn options selected: y_e + y_e' <= 1.

constraints.name: eq_0017
constraints.description: If arrival is short-turn station, departure is cancelled: c_e' >= y_e.

constraints.name: eq_0018
constraints.description: If arrival is short-turn station, arrival is kept: c_e <= 1 - y_e.

constraints.name: eq_0019
constraints.description: If departure is short-turn station, arrival is cancelled: c_e >= y_e'.

constraints.name: eq_0020
constraints.description: If departure is short-turn station, departure is kept: c_e' <= 1 - y_e'.

constraints.name: eq_0021
constraints.description: At entry side, at least one short-turn station chosen if cancelled: sum y_e >= c_e'.

constraints.name: eq_0022
constraints.description: At exit side, at least one short-turn station chosen if cancelled: sum y_e' >= c_e.

constraints.name: eq_0024
constraints.description: Number of short-turn stations at exit side bounded by cancelled arrivals.

constraints.name: eq_0025
constraints.description: At most one selected short-turn activity per event (tail side, single disruption).

constraints.name: eq_0026
constraints.description: At most one selected short-turn activity per event (head side, single disruption).

constraints.name: eq_0027
constraints.description: At most one selected short-turn activity per event (tail side, multiple disruptions).

constraints.name: eq_0028
constraints.description: At most one selected short-turn activity per event (head side, multiple disruptions).

constraints.name: eq_0032
constraints.description: Events not yet occurred cannot be rescheduled before new disruption start.

constraints.name: eq_0034
constraints.description: Departures within recovery time after max disruption end cannot be cancelled or delayed.

constraints.name: eq_0040
constraints.description: Arrival at destination must be assigned a platform track.

constraints.name: eq_0041
constraints.description: Platform track headway between two arrivals (station activity).

constraints.name: eq_0043
constraints.description: Pass-through track headway between two arrivals (station activity).

constraints.name: eq_0045_a
constraints.description: Auxiliary constraint for event ordering q (part a).

constraints.name: eq_0047_a
constraints.description: Auxiliary constraint for event ordering on platform tracks (part a).

constraints.name: eq_0048_a
constraints.description: Auxiliary station capacity constraint for platform tracks (part a).

constraints.name: eq_0050_a
constraints.description: Auxiliary constraint for added-stop variable s_a (part a).

constraints.name: eq_0051
constraints.description: Auxiliary constraint for added-stop variable s_a (part c).

constraints.name: eq_0053
constraints.description: Auxiliary constraint for determining s_a (part d).

constraints.name: eq_0055
constraints.description: Auxiliary constraint for determining s_a (part f).

constraints.name: eq_0058
constraints.description: Auxiliary constraint for OD turn activities (part a).

constraints.name: eq_0060
constraints.description: Auxiliary constraint for OD turn activities (part c).

objective.name: objective
objective.description: Minimize total weighted cancellations and delays: sum_{e in E_ar} w c_e + sum_{e in E_ar union E_de} d_e.
